P1_thk_cog_significant.requirement: T1Hier_thk -> CogPC1 significant (p < 0.05) in >=4 of 5 splits

P2_star_vs_complete_loglik.requirement: OOS loglik delta (star - complete) >= 0 on average or within 1 SE

P3_reconstructed_cog_r2.requirement: Reconstructed CogPC1 out-of-sample R^2 >= 0.15 on average for winning topology
P3_reconstructed_cog_r2.note: Confounds age, education, head size partial out substantial variance; correlation r = 0.354 (r^2 = 0.125).

P4_refit_conservative_ratio.requirement: Refit null per-edge p-values conservative vs fixed null (mean ratio >= 1.0)

Section8_vol_thk_p_maxt.requirement: T1Hier_vol - T1Hier_thk held-out p_maxt < 0.05 in >=4 of 5 splits

Section8_outcome_holm.requirement: Outcome node has at least one view with p_holm < 0.05 in >=4 of 5 splits

Section8_heldout_below_train_pillai.requirement: Fixed-model held-out pillai below training pillai for every edge

Section8_complete_not_best_every_split.requirement: Complete graph is not best by heldout_loglik in every split
